items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: when it came to beating Millender in this battle, I take it that that was really the band

ctx.x: And everybody heard it. So that night, you couldn't get close to the bandstand for musicians. Everybody, man, who was that band? You hear that saxophone player? Who was that?
Well, when it came to beating Millender in this battle, I take it that that was really the band, --
